summary: An excerpt from a military fiction chapter ("Book 15 — part 48") in which Ray, a gunnery sergeant, rides with Lieutenant Holcomb, comm specialist Kev Whitfield and others in a helicopter at night over the desert near Karbala, with a Predator drone following. The narrative mixes wry commentary on officers, METOC staff and the army's "Disneyland of Officer Training" with sensory detail of the flight, distant bombing of industrial sites, and Ray's struggle to stay awake. The passage ends as the pilot prepares a flyover of the drop zone before hovering three klicks east to wait.
one_line: Gunny Ray and Lieutenant Holcomb fly a night helicopter run over the desert near Karbala during a fictional war against Russoturk forces.
key_facts: The narrator says sergeants are "the entertainment directors" of the military, a joking claim in the passage.
METOC staff regarded the mission as "a lark being granted to a highly connected young officer with too much classical education and too much imagination."
Ray was ordered to help toughen up the LT and show him "what New Mes and the real world look like without him getting killed."
The mission is set at about 2300 hours New Mes local time.
The helicopters fly at a height of ten meters while kicking up sand.
Ray, Lieutenant Holcomb, comm specialist Kev Whitfield and others ride in the lead chopper.
The rest of the team rides in a Predator following behind, tracking the route mainly by infrared imaging.
Kev Whitfield carries an M202 (subby) across his knees.
East of the route lie the scant, twinkling lights of Karbala.
The 8th Tactical Wing bombers are heard shouting toward industrial complexes on the city's fringes.
The Russoturk armored divisions are hunkered down to escape allied smart bombs.
Ray blames his parents for his tendency to fall asleep in helicopters, since they spent hours of his first two years celebrating the American love of the open road while he had colic.
The pilot tells Ray they are about a minute from the drop point and will flyover the zone to check it is clear.
The helicopter will hover three klicks east and wait for Ray's signal.
